mapper.select: SELECT f.* FROM flashcard f INNER JOIN flashcard_deck d ON f.deck_id = d.id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND f.next_review_date <= #{today} AND f.status = 1 AND d.status = 1 ORDER BY f.next_review_date ASC, f.id ASC
SELECT f.* FROM flashcard f INNER JOIN flashcard_deck d ON f.deck_id = d.id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND f.status != 0 ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM flashcard WHERE deck_id = #{deckId} AND status != 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE flashcard SET deck_id = #{deckId}, question = #{question}, answer = #{answer}, next_review_date = #{nextReviewDate}, stage = #{stage}, review_count = #{reviewCount}, correct_count = #{correctCount}, wrong_count = #{wrongCount}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
